data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate's opening gross claims reserves at 1 January 2023 were GBP 792.7m. Management report an improvement in prior year reserves for 2022 and 2021 driven by favourable claims development, particularly in longer-tail and specialty classes. No explicit gross prior-year movement amount is disclosed (movement tables are distorted by external reinsurance-to-close entries), but narrative indicates an overall release in prior year reserves despite significant RITC and other movements affecting reported gross outstanding balances.

data.data_quality_notes: No explicit GROSS prior-year reserve movement number is reported. The technical provisions movement and claims outstanding reconciliation include large 'External RITC movements' which distort direct interpretation of year-on-year reserve changes and make the claims development triangle unreliable for computing a clean prior-year development. The narrative states an improvement for 2022 & 2021 but quantification is not provided in gross terms. Prior-year development therefore left null and direction inferred from management commentary.
